title: Operations List Request 1.0
description: An untrusted request to list operations. It carries only a bounded page size (max 50), an optional opaque cursor, and optional coarse filters. It has no identity, credential, tenant, or free-text field; the backend resolves scope from the verified caller, never from this body.

page_size.description: Maximum number of operations to return. Bounded to 50; the backend clamps and never exceeds it.

opaque_cursor.description: An opaque, base64url-encoded continuation token minted by the backend. A client echoes it verbatim and never constructs or parses it. A tampered cursor is rejected.
